parties.respondent: The State of Andhra Pradesh & Ors.

summary: The appellant, ranked 34th in a recruitment process for 33 teacher vacancies, sought appointment after one selected candidate did not attend counselling. The Administrative Tribunal directed his appointment relying on G.O. Ms. No. 91 dated 03.11.2012, but the High Court quashed this order, holding the selection process complete upon publication of the final list. The Supreme Court examined whether the vacancy arising from non-joining before appointment could be filled from the merit list, considering Rule 16(5) of the Andhra Pradesh Direct Recruitment Rules, 2012 and Guidelines under G.O. Ms. No. 91. The Court emphasized that no waiting list was permitted and that the final selection list under Rule 8(g) concluded the process. It distinguished prior cases and upheld the High Court's decision.
